message.content:
Below is a quick‑look list of the **federal long‑weekends** that Canadians enjoyed in 2023.  
(If you’re targeting a specific province, keep in mind that many provinces have their own holidays—Family Day, St. Patrick’s Day, etc.—that can create extra long weekends.)

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Observed (if weekend) | Long‑Weekend Span | Notes |
|---------|-------------|-----------------------|-------------------|-------|
| **New Year’s Day** | Sunday Jan 1 | Monday Jan 2 | **Jan 1–3** | Observed on Monday because the holiday fell on a Sunday. |
| **Family Day (Ontario)** | Monday Feb 20 | — | **Feb 18–20** | Third Monday in February (Ontario only). |
| **Good Friday** | Friday Apr 7 | — | **Apr 7–9** | Friday + weekend. |
| **Victoria Day** | Monday May 22 | — | **May 20–22** | Celebrated on the last Monday before May 25. |
| **Canada Day** | Saturday Jul 1 | Monday Jul 3 | **Jul 1–3** | Observed on Monday because the holiday fell on a Saturday. |
| **Labour Day** | Monday Sep 4 | — | **Sep 2–4** | First Monday in September. |
| **Thanksgiving** | Monday Oct 9 | — | **Oct 7–9** | Second Monday in October. |
| **Remembrance Day** | Saturday Nov 11 | Monday Nov 13 | **Nov 11–13** | Observed on Monday because the holiday fell on a Saturday. |
| **Christmas Day** | Monday Dec 25 | — | **Dec 23–25** | Monday holiday. |
| **Boxing Day** | Tuesday Dec 26 | — | — | Not a long weekend (falls on a weekday). |

### Quick Summary

| Month | Long‑Weekend Dates | Holiday |
|-------|--------------------|---------|
| January | Jan 1–3 | New Year’s Day |
| February | Feb 18–20 | Family Day (Ontario) |
| April | Apr 7–9 | Good Friday |
| May | May 20–22 | Victoria Day |
| July | Jul 1–3 | Canada Day |
| September | Sep 2–4 | Labour Day |
| October | Oct 7–9 | Thanksgiving |
| November | Nov 11–13 | Remembrance Day |
| December | Dec 23–25 | Christmas Day |

> **Tip for your app:**  
> • If you need province‑specific long weekends, add the relevant holidays (e.g., Family Day in Alberta on the second Monday in February, St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland on March 17, etc.).  
> • For holidays that fall on a weekend, Canada observes the holiday on the following Monday (or preceding Friday for some provinces), so the long‑weekend usually spans the weekend plus the observed day.

Feel free to let me know if you’d like the list broken down by province or if you need any other holiday data!
